notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by an ordinary interaction. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback model, and transportation/type names. It verifies transportation handle/name round-trips, ordinary interaction publication, subscription, send and receive delivery, received transportation identity, and the standard interaction transportation query without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador FOM transportation lookup, interaction publication/subscription/send, and transportation query services with FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador transportation and interaction declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
